svg.title: awharness: 98 bricks in 8 layers
svg.text: The super agent harness · Aither World Harness · 98 bricks in 8 layers, each installable on its own
3 siblings: a brick wears the colour of each one that composes it

g.title: awharness — Aither World Harness: One name for the kit, the shell and the bricks an agent works with, taken together. It is a harness that sits above other harnesses: the shell drives Claude Code, Codex and the rest as real products, and the bricks give every one of them the same memory, jobs, leases, permits and tools.
g.text: bricks (11): awdk · awsh · awskills · awm · awgraph ·
awrun · awrise · awgit · awpermit · awrelay · awnode

g.title: awmodel — Aither World Model: The pieces that predict what an environment does next and score how wrong the prediction was. An agent run by the harness asks it before acting; a world run by the engine is one of the things it is asked about.
g.text: Predict what the world does next

g.title: awengine — Aither World Engine: The pieces that run a world: a story takes a turn a checker can refuse, a simulation advances by a tick, and the platform's own senses are rolled forward as a dream. The harness runs the agents that live in these worlds; the model is what predicts them.
g.text: Run worlds, and imagine what comes next in them

g.title: awtab — Aither World Tab, a product: One browser tab runs a 1-bit language model on the visitor's GPU through WebGPU, a tool-calling agent loop and an on-device embedder. There is no inference server: the model, the tools and the search all run inside the tab.
g.text: A whole agent in one browser tab
bricks (1): awkit — not bricks (4): webml-runtime · tab-tool-loop · tab-embedder · gobbonet-chat

g.title: awrun — A priority-aware queue and dispatcher for agentic runs and ad-hoc CI builds. It also judges whether the runner pool is big enough for the queue it is draining, and can ask a host to grow it — reserving capacity is zero-sum, so a saturated pool needs more of it, not a different share of it. (public); composed by awharness
